unit_sale_price.non_compliance_reason: Rule 6(11) prescribes only the form of a unit sale price declaration -- 'The unit sale price shall be declared as' -- and the Rule 6(1) enumerated list (a), (aa), (b), (c), (d), (da), (e), (f), (g) carries no unit-sale-price item. The corpus therefore holds no obligation limb a deterministic rule could find in breach, so a missing declaration routes to human review rather than FAIL. Source: rules-corpus/LMPC-2011__amended-to-2021-10-31__maharashtra-compilation.pdf, Rule 6(11).

country_of_origin.non_compliance_reason: Rule 6(1)(aa) requires the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly 'in case of imported products'. Every address legible on this face is Indian and nothing on it indicates an imported product, so the obligation does not arise. Source: rules-corpus/LMPC-2011__amended-to-2021-10-31__maharashtra-compilation.pdf, Rule 6(1)(aa). The pack carries the statement even so; an obligation that does not arise is NOT_APPLICABLE, not PASS, even where the label happens to satisfy it.

notes: Back face of the carton. White and yellow type on dark red across most of the panel, hence low_contrast. The manufacturing address is declared by indirection -- the pack directs the reader to the first character of the Lot No., and Lot No. B244 begins with B, resolving to unit B) at Baddi -- so the address is complete once resolved. Compare cosmetics_colgate_strong_teeth_100g_002, where the same indirection does not resolve. No unit sale price anywhere on the pack. No reference object of known size is in frame, so no millimetre letter or numeral height is measurable and no Rule 7 Table-I finding is supportable. pdp.is_measurable is false and every height field is null. The sample verdict is REVIEW for that reason alone, independently of what the declarations show.
